title: Let's get started on your adjustments to income.
text: Let's get started on your adjustments to income. We'll look for any expenses that can reduce your taxable income and give you a bigger refund. Some common adjustments include: Student loan interest payments K–12 teachers' classroom and professional development expenses Alimony payments IRA, SEP-IRA, SIMPLE IRA, and Keogh contributions Health insurance premiums, if you're self-employed High deductible health plans contributions and distributions, like health savings accounts (HSAs) -- Don't confuse this with your health care coverage. We'll get to that later in the Taxes section
